q: Identify the error: 'He do not like tea.'
exp: 'He' is third person singular; should be 'does not'. Answer: do not

q: Identify the error: 'She don't go to school.'
Identify the error: 'The childrens are playing.'
exp: 'Children' is already plural; 'childrens' is incorrect. Answer: childrens

q: Identify the error: 'He give me a book.'
exp: Third person singular requires 'gives'. Answer: give

q: Identify the error: 'I has a pen.'
Identify the error: 'He is one of the best player.'
exp: 'One of the' requires plural noun: 'players'. Answer: best player

q: Identify the error: 'Each of the boys have a pen.'
exp: 'Each' is singular; should be 'has'. Answer: have

q: Identify the error: 'The number of students are increasing.'
exp: 'The number of' takes singular verb: 'is increasing'. Answer: are increasing

q: Identify the error: 'He discussed about the problem.'
exp: 'Discuss' is transitive; 'about' is redundant. Answer: discussed about

q: Identify the error: 'I am living here since 2010.'
exp: For state since a point in time, use 'I have been living'. Answer: I am

q: Identify the error: 'He is senior than me.'
Identify the error: 'Neither of the two brothers were honest.'
exp: 'Neither' is singular; should be 'was'. Answer: were

q: Identify the error: 'A number of students is absent today.'
exp: 'A number of' takes plural verb: 'are absent'. Answer: is absent

q: Identify the error: 'He is one of the oldest man in the village.'
exp: 'One of the oldest' requires plural: 'men'. Answer: man

q: Identify the error: 'I would rather to die than beg.'
exp: 'Would rather' takes bare infinitive: 'would rather die'. Answer: rather to die
